Definition: Obed-Edom, the name of five Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Obed-Edom the Gittite is the man whose house received the ark when David would not bring it to Jerusalem. In 2 Samuel 6:10 David carries the ark aside into his house, and in 2 Samuel 6:11 it stays there three months, and the Lord blesses Obed-Edom and all his household.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that blessing follows the ark, and the house that welcomes God's presence is the house God blesses.
RelatedEvents: David Brings the Ark to Jerusalem
